title: Module settings — saving, restoring, how it works
body:
Most modules have their own settings screen: on the Modules tab you open it with the
**„Setting”** link that appears next to the row of a switched-on module. One screen is always about one module — you do not
have to search through long settings pages.

A quicker way from the menu: in the left-hand menu, the list of your modules drops down under **„Modules”**
(on a phone the same in the **„Menu”** drawer). Clicking a module's name opens its
settings straight away, and the list highlights where you are. On the Modules tab and on the
modules' screens the list is open by itself; on other tabs you can open it with the small arrow next to **„Modules”**.
The list shows the modules that have a settings screen.

![Screenshot: a module's settings screen on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## What does a settings screen look like?

The screen's title is the module's name. Above it you can always find your way back with the **„Back to modules”** link (with a ‹ arrow in front of the label);
below the title are the module's fee (if it has one) and the **„Guide to this screen”** button, which opens this help. (The Online booking
screen is the exception: there, in a dark header block, the fee sits next to the title, and the back link and the guide below the title.) Below that, in a pale block, come the fields: switches, texts, numbers — each with a short explanation
of what it is for. On the special screens (booking calendar, rooms, prices, amenities) the rule fields sit under the
**„Rules”** heading; you rarely need to change these — they work out of the box.

## Saving

The **„Save settings”** button records what you have set. After saving, your website
**is rebuilt straight away** with the new settings — there is no separate publishing step, and you do not have to
wait for anything. If we could not save something (for example, a field is invalid), we say exactly what to fix at the top of the
screen.

**Exception: the “Map, directions” screen.** At its top are the property's address and the map pin
(the **„Property location”** card), so the button there is called **„Save and refresh”**, and one save stores the address, the
pin and the directions text together. Errors in the address or the pin are shown below the field there. The details
are in the Contact help (the question-mark icon in the card's header takes you there).

## I've made a mistake — can I undo it?

Yes. If you have saved settings before, the
**„Back to previous”** button appears next to the save button — with one tap it restores the state before the last save.
Feel free to experiment: a bad save is not final.

On the “Map, directions” screen, **„Back to previous”** restores only the directions fields (map on/off,
“How do guests find you?”, parking) — **not the address or the map pin**. The pin is put back where you last saved it by the
**„Back to the saved location”** button below the map; the old address you type back into the
“Address” field.

## Why can't I see a module's settings?

The **„Setting”** link appears only for switched-on modules — first switch the module on in the
showcase (**„Add to cart”**), and finalise it in the basket (for a paid module with the
**„Continue to payment”** button). There are a few modules with
nothing to set: they work correctly on their own.
